events.title: Ukraine's Battlefield Optimism Wanes as Russian Pressure on Donbas Defense Belt Mounts

events.title: PISA 2025 Results Show Global Plunge in Reading and Math Scores; U.S. Reaches 20-Year Low
events.one_liner: The 2025 PISA international assessment reveals a worldwide decline in student reading and math scores, with U.S. performance at its lowest in two decades.

events.title: China's 'Clean Internet' Campaign Suppresses Information About Nepal-Tibet Border Disaster
